notes.title: Massive Update: Graphics, Gameplay & Enhanced Content!
notes.content: [p][/p][h3]🎨 Graphics & Atmosphere[/h3][list][*][p]Completely reworked cats, enemies, and environments[/p][/*][*][p]New visual effects for attacks, artifacts, and environments[/p][/*][*][p]10 different, more immersive and stylish environments[/p][/*][/list][h3]🛠️ Redesigned gameplay[/h3][list][*][p][b]The Wheel spins endlessly: improve damage, speed, earn diamonds, and more.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Place up to 3 cats in battle.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Each cat has a unique attack to target specific enemies.[/b][/p][/*][/list][h3]💎 Economy & progression[/h3][list][*][p]Cats can be purchased with Purple Orbs (from bosses, resale of cats, or exchanged for diamonds)[/p][/*][*][p]30 playable cats, each fully upgradeable[/p][/*][*][p]30 enemy types and 10 bosses, unlocked throughout the game[/p][/*][/list][h3]🗝️ Artifacts & Strategy[/h3][list][*][p]Artifacts to obtain: very rare on enemies, more common on bosses.[/p][/*][*][p]They offer bonuses: increased attack, attack speed, extra cat, and more.[/p][/*][*][p]Think about your combos: cat + artifact = optimized build.[/p][/*][/list][p]This update greatly enriches the experience: more control, strategy, and visual and playful challenges. 👉 The bosses from the trailer are here, and more will be added gradually.[/p][p]Thank you for your feedback and support! Join me on Discord to discuss it.[/p][p]DISCORD:[/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/hUZqydbCbJ"]https://discord.gg/hUZqydbCbJ[/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://media2.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExbG1nOWUwZjh3ZmpjaTRvcndsdjM3cG01MHp3azkwY2NyYTYyYTBmYyZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/v6HmjWFF80ByC2JcRl/giphy.gif"][/img][/p]

tags.feature: Completely reworked cats, enemies, and environments
New visual effects for attacks, artifacts, and environments
10 different, more immersive and stylish environments
The Wheel spins endlessly: improve damage, speed, earn diamonds, and more.
Place up to 3 cats in battle.
Each cat has a unique attack to target specific enemies.
Cats can be purchased with Purple Orbs (from bosses, resale of cats, or exchanged for diamonds)
30 playable cats, each fully upgradeable
30 enemy types and 10 bosses, unlocked throughout the game
Artifacts to obtain: very rare on enemies, more common on bosses.
They offer bonuses: increased attack, attack speed, extra cat, and more.
Think about your combos: cat + artifact = optimized build.

notes.title: 🎉 1000 wishlists! Thank you for your support!
notes.content:
A huge thank you to everyone who added Vampire Cat to their wishlist and provided feedback during the [b]Creature Collection[/b] and [b]Zombie vs. Vampire[/b] festivals. Your feedback motivates me enormously, and I'm preparing some big changes for the sequel, which will arrive a little later:

[list]
[*] The wheel will now spin [b]infinitely[/b]
[*] You will be able to control [b]3 cats[/b] at the same time
[*] Each cat will have a [b]unique ability[/b] to defeat enemies
[*] [b]Bosses[/b] will challenge your runs
[*] Cats will no longer be unlocked automatically... you will have to [b]purchase[/b] them
[*] With each CashOut, [b]the wheel will change shape[/b]
[*]
[/list]

I'm continuing to work on other features and new features. Thanks again.
